That sounds like a promising direction. What mechanism actually makes it work?

Chinook paired forward search with solved endgame tables, letting the program connect current choices to proven late-game outcomes. The key mechanism is Alpha-beta search plus endgame databases, which links the source material to the visible demo behavior.

Experts generally treat Chinook as a landmark in game-solving research and high-performance search. Its long-term legacy is showing how expert evaluation, alpha-beta search, opening knowledge, and endgame databases can combine to approach perfect play.
Seen alongside Christopher Strachey's Draughts, Chinook reveals how the same technical question can echo across different eras.
